run: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const click = async (sel, ms) => { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (!el) throw new Error('no ' + sel); el.click(); await wait(ms || 600); };

const type = async (sel, text, ms) => { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (!el) throw new Error('no ' + sel); el.focus(); el.value = text; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await wait(ms || 700); };
const mock = async (path) => { const r = await fetch(path, { method: 'POST' }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(path + ' ' + r.status); };

const enter = async (hash) => { location.hash = '#/t/t1/matches'; await wait(900); location.hash = hash; await wait(1500); if (!document.querySelector('[data-screen="team-challenges"]')) throw new Error('not on the challenges page'); };
